project_type: FastAPI Python backend service for MediHistory AI
build_system: pip with requirements.txt; no build step — run directly with uvicorn. Working directory for all commands is backend/.
test_framework: pytest==8.2.2 with pytest-asyncio==0.23.7 and httpx==0.27.0 AsyncClient. Run with: cd backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v. asyncio_mode = 'auto' must be set in pytest config.
verification_instructions: 1. cd backend  2. pip install -r requirements.txt  3. Set env vars: $env:JWT_SECRET_KEY='synthetic-test-secret-for-ci'; $env:DATABASE_URL='sqlite+aiosqlite:///./test.db'  4. python -m alembic -c migrations/alembic.ini upgrade head  5. python -m pytest tests/ -v  All tests must pass.
snapshot_or_generated_files: migrations/versions/*.py — generated by 'alembic revision --autogenerate'. Must be committed. No other generated files.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. Set JWT_SECRET_KEY env var before running anything — app/core/security.py reads os.environ['JWT_SECRET_KEY'] at module load time and raises KeyError if absent. DATABASE_URL defaults to 'sqlite+aiosqlite:///./medihistory.db' if not set. UPLOAD_DIR defaults to './uploads'. Tests use in-memory SQLite via DATABASE_URL override in conftest.py. Never push to remote. Commit only locally on the branch.
contribution_requirements: All secrets via env vars, never hardcoded. Synthetic test data only (fake patient names like 'Test Patient Alpha', fake doctor names like 'Dr. Synthetic', fake medicines like 'Synthamol 500mg'). Test naming: test_{outcome}_{condition}. Every router: happy path, 401 unauthenticated, 404 cross-patient, 422 validation. Privacy: never log tokens, prescription text, medicine names, file contents in Logcat or server logs. Error shape: {"error": {"code": "...", "message": "...", "details": {}}}.
key_patterns: Existing routers use: APIRouter with prefix + tags, Depends(get_current_patient) for auth, service classes passed via Depends(). Error responses currently use HTTPException — must be migrated to raise_http_error() helper from app/core/errors.py (to be created). All ORM-backed Pydantic schemas need model_config = {'from_attributes': True}. The patient_auth middleware helper require_patient_owns_resource(resource_patient_id, current_patient_id) raises HTTP 404 for cross-patient access. Async SQLAlchemy: AsyncSession from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio, select() queries, async with session.begin() or session.commit(). UUIDs: generate with str(uuid.uuid4()) in Python, store as String(36) in SQLite.
directory_structure: backend/ — project root for all commands. backend/app/ — FastAPI application package. backend/app/core/ — security.py (JWT dep), database.py (to create), config.py (to create), errors.py (to create). backend/app/middleware/ — rate_limit.py, patient_auth.py. backend/app/models/ — SQLAlchemy ORM models (all to create). backend/app/routers/ — auth.py (extend), all other routers to create. backend/app/schemas/ — Pydantic schemas, auth.py (extend), all others to create. backend/app/services/ — auth_service.py (extend), all others to create. backend/migrations/ — Alembic config and versions (to create). backend/tests/ — test_auth.py, test_security.py (existing), all new test files to create.
